name: Import from Gitea
description: Mirrors a Gitea repo's scripts/ + conf/runners/ into this instance. Overwrites existing files with the latest version, and REMOVES files that this same source previously imported but no longer has upstream (e.g. you deleted/renamed a script in Gitea) - only files previously imported from this exact url+owner+repo are ever candidates for removal, nothing else under scripts/ or conf/runners/ is touched. Dry-run by default (lists what would change, writes nothing) - check 'apply' to actually sync. Private repo: set a Gitea access token in the 'token' field.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Gitea access token (only needed for private repos)

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Actually sync files (otherwise dry-run only, listing what would change)
